Sandbox_DazedPlumb_NeedWrench: Pipe work needs a pipe wrench
Sandbox_DazedPlumb_NeedWrench_tooltip: Laying, mending and cutting pipe and fitting valves need a pipe wrench in your inventory. Turning a valve does not.
Sandbox_DazedPlumb_MainReach_tooltip: How far a water main may stand from the building it serves. Default 6.
Sandbox_DazedPlumb_MainFlow: Water main line rate (litres a minute)
Sandbox_DazedPlumb_MainFlow_tooltip: The most water one main delivers to its whole house each minute, shared among the fixtures. Default 30.
